tests.title: A repository with no host is on github.com
Host, scheme, trailing slash and nested owner
then: the results are https://gitlab.com/group/subgroup/repo, http://forge.internal/team/tool and https://git.example.com/o/n
tests.pseudocode: for repo, want in cases: assert repo.WebURL() == want

tests.title: IssueRef.URL is unchanged for any reference
given: a copy of IssueRef.URL as it was before this change, kept in the test
references over hosts (empty, github.com, gitlab.com, a self-hosted GitLab, http:// and https:// prefixes, a trailing slash), owners (flat and nested), numbers and IsPullRequest
tests.when: for any such reference, URL is called
then: the result equals the copy's result
tests.pseudocode: for ref in refs: assert ref.URL() == oldURL(ref)

tests.title: An origin remote in a GitLab subgroup becomes its project page
tests.when: ParseRemote parses it and WebURL is called on the result
